patch_description: Revert the ansatz to the higher-scoring 2-parameter structure (ry_a for pre-rotation, theta shared across RZ/ZZ/XX layers) that previously achieved combined_score=0.74, and augment it per the recommendation with an additional CRZ nearest-neighbor ring reusing the same "theta" parameter, inserted right after the existing XX layer. This adds a fundamentally different (controlled-phase) entangling interaction without introducing any new trainable parameter names, further enriching the reachable operator space and potentially improving worst-group separation while keeping parameter count minimal (n_distinct_params=2).
